title: Restocking Rate by Installation Bookings on Lapsed Orders — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
On a lapsed Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty order, the restocking rate follows the order's installation bookings, and the restocking fee is that rate percent of the tire price paid.

| Installation appointments booked for the order | Restocking rate |
|---|---|
| none ever booked | no restocking fee |
| exactly one | half of the line's restocking percentage |
| more than one | the line's full restocking percentage |

Every booking counts, including a booking later moved to another slot.

| Line | Full restocking percentage | Half |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 0% |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 0% |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 10% | 5% |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 15% | 7.5% |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 10% | 5% |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 10% | 5% |

**Cases (hypothetical tire price paid of $400.00 on a 10% line):** no booking — $0.00; one booking — 5%, $20.00; three bookings — 10%, $40.00.
